description: Choose one bounded coding-work profile from observable task properties

decision.instructions: Choose the work profile. Use standard whenever the evidence is incomplete, mixed, ambiguous, or uncertain.

criteria.economy: Narrow, explicit, local, mechanically verifiable work with low ambiguity and no security, deployment, migration, architecture, or high-consequence sensitivity
criteria.standard: Ordinary implementation or diagnosis, mixed work, incomplete context, boundary cases, or any uncertain classification
criteria.deep: Cross-component architecture, difficult debugging, security-sensitive work, migrations, unclear repeated failures, concurrency, or other high-consequence work
